data.name: immutable_metric_semantics
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_metric_semantics BEFORE UPDATE ON metric_definitions
WHEN NEW.id != OLD.id OR NEW.version != OLD.version OR NEW.skill_id != OLD.skill_id
  OR NEW.label != OLD.label OR NEW.unit_key != OLD.unit_key OR NEW.value_type != OLD.value_type
  OR NEW.direction != OLD.direction OR NEW.target_value IS NOT OLD.target_value
  OR NEW.scale_min IS NOT OLD.scale_min OR NEW.scale_max IS NOT OLD.scale_max OR NEW.source_hint != OLD.source_hint
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'metric_version_immutable');
END;

BEGIN

END;

data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER legal_session_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON sessions
WHEN NEW.skill_id != OLD.skill_id OR NEW.id != OLD.id OR NEW.entry_mode != OLD.entry_mode
  OR NEW.manual_intent IS NOT OLD.manual_intent
  OR NEW.revision != OLD.revision + 1
  OR (NEW.status != OLD.status AND NOT (
    (OLD.status = 'draft' AND NEW.status IN ('running','completed','discarded')) OR
    (OLD.status = 'running' AND NEW.status IN ('paused','completed','discarded')) OR
    (OLD.status = 'paused' AND NEW.status IN ('running','completed','discarded'))))
  OR NEW.active_seconds < COALESCE((SELECT SUM(allocated_seconds) FROM session_exercises WHERE session_id = OLD.id), 0)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'session_conflict');
END;

data.name: validate_exercise_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER validate_exercise_insert BEFORE INSERT ON session_exercises
WHEN (NEW.exercise_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM exercises e JOIN sessions s ON s.id = NEW.session_id
    WHERE e.id = NEW.exercise_id AND e.skill_id = s.skill_id))
  OR COALESCE(NEW.allocated_seconds, 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(allocated_seconds) FROM session_exercises WHERE session_id = NEW.session_id), 0)
    > (SELECT active_seconds FROM sessions WHERE id = NEW.session_id)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'exercise_allocation');
END;

data.name: validate_exercise_update
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER validate_exercise_update BEFORE UPDATE ON session_exercises
WHEN (NEW.exercise_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM exercises e JOIN sessions s ON s.id = NEW.session_id
    WHERE e.id = NEW.exercise_id AND e.skill_id = s.skill_id))
  OR COALESCE(NEW.allocated_seconds, 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(allocated_seconds) FROM session_exercises
    WHERE session_id = NEW.session_id AND NOT (session_id = OLD.session_id AND ordinal = OLD.ordinal)), 0)
    > (SELECT active_seconds FROM sessions WHERE id = NEW.session_id)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'exercise_allocation');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER validate_reading_insert BEFORE INSERT ON metric_readings
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM metric_definitions d JOIN sessions s ON s.id = NEW.session_id
  WHERE d.id = NEW.metric_definition_id AND d.version = NEW.definition_version AND d.skill_id = s.skill_id
  AND ((d.value_type = 'numeric' AND NEW.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.text_value IS NULL AND NEW.bool_value IS NULL
    AND (d.scale_min IS NULL OR NEW.numeric_value >= d.scale_min) AND (d.scale_max IS NULL OR NEW.numeric_value <= d.scale_max))
    OR (d.value_type = 'text' AND NEW.text_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.numeric_value IS NULL AND NEW.bool_value IS NULL)
    OR (d.value_type = 'checklist' AND NEW.bool_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.text_value IS NULL AND NEW.numeric_value IS NULL)))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'reading_type_range_skill');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length("key") BETWEEN 1 AND 128), "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value_json)), "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "skills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('music', 'drawing', 'language', 'programming', 'voice', 'typing', 'movement', 'custom')), "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "accent_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_utc" INTEGER, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "default_practice_minutes" INTEGER CHECK (default_practice_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 1440));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "metric_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1), "skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096), "unit_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_type IN ('numeric', 'checklist', 'text')), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('up', 'down', 'toward_target', 'none')), "target_value" REAL CHECK (abs(target_value) <= CAST('1.7976931348623157e308' AS REAL)), "scale_min" REAL CHECK (abs(scale_min) <= CAST('1.7976931348623157e308' AS REAL)), "scale_max" REAL CHECK (abs(scale_max) <= CAST('1.7976931348623157e308' AS REAL)), "source_hint" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_hint IN ('manual', 'instrument', 'self_rating')), "archived_at_utc" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(id, version), UNIQUE(id, version, skill_id), CHECK(scale_min IS NULL OR scale_max IS NULL OR scale_min <= scale_max), CHECK(direction != 'toward_target' OR target_value IS NOT NULL), CHECK(target_value IS NULL OR((scale_min IS NULL OR target_value >= scale_min)AND(scale_max IS NULL OR target_value <= scale_max))));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('cumulative', 'threshold', 'weekly_target', 'deliverable', 'qualitative')), "metric_definition_id" TEXT, "definition_version" INTEGER, "target_value" REAL CHECK (abs(target_value) <= CAST('1.7976931348623157e308' AS REAL)), "target_unit" TEXT, "target_date_local" TEXT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed', 'paused', 'archived')), "completed_at_utc" INTEGER, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(metric_definition_id, definition_version, skill_id)REFERENCES metric_definitions(id, version, skill_id), CHECK((metric_definition_id IS NULL)=(definition_version IS NULL)), CHECK((status = 'completed')=(completed_at_utc IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(type NOT IN ('cumulative', 'weekly_target') OR(target_value IS NOT NULL AND target_value > 0)), CHECK(type != 'threshold' OR(target_value IS NOT NULL AND metric_definition_id IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "template_id" TEXT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096), "instructions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "default_seconds" INTEGER CHECK (default_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 86400), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(skill_id, template_id));
CREATE INDEX exercises_skill_sort ON exercises (skill_id, sort_order)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "started_at_utc" INTEGER, "ended_at_utc" INTEGER, "active_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (active_seconds >= 0), "entry_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_mode IN ('timed', 'manual')), "manual_intent" TEXT CHECK (manual_intent IN ('duration', 'evidence_only')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'running', 'paused', 'completed', 'discarded')), "interruption_reason" TEXT, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0), "note" TEXT, "next_step" TEXT, "effort_rating" INTEGER CHECK (effort_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "local_display_zone" TEXT, "source_device_id" TEXT, CHECK((entry_mode = 'manual')=(manual_intent IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(entry_mode != 'manual' OR status NOT IN ('running', 'paused')), CHECK(status != 'running' OR started_at_utc IS NOT NULL), CHECK(status != 'completed' OR ended_at_utc IS NOT NULL), CHECK(ended_at_utc IS NULL OR started_at_utc IS NULL OR ended_at_utc >= started_at_utc), CHECK(entry_mode != 'manual' OR status != 'completed' OR active_seconds > 0 OR manual_intent = 'evidence_only'));
CREATE INDEX sessions_skill_end ON sessions (skill_id, ended_at_utc)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_running_session ON sessions (status) WHERE status = 'running'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT REFERENCES exercises(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "exercise_title_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), "allocated_seconds" INTEGER CHECK (allocated_seconds >= 0), "result_note" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(session_id, ordinal));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "metric_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "metric_definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "numeric_value" REAL CHECK (abs(numeric_value) <= CAST('1.7976931348623157e308' AS REAL)), "text_value" TEXT, "bool_value" INTEGER CHECK (bool_value IN (0, 1)), "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('self_reported', 'instrument_import', 'derived')), "source_note" TEXT, "measured_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(metric_definition_id, definition_version)REFERENCES metric_definitions(id, version), UNIQUE(session_id, metric_definition_id));
CREATE INDEX readings_definition_measured ON metric_readings (metric_definition_id, measured_at_utc)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('image', 'audio')), "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_length > 0), "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "thumbnail_relative_path" TEXT UNIQUE, "duration_ms" INTEGER CHECK (duration_ms >= 0), "width" INTEGER CHECK (width > 0), "height" INTEGER CHECK (height > 0), "label" TEXT, "is_baseline" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_baseline IN (0, 1)), "capture_source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (capture_source IN ('camera', 'microphone', 'file_import')), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "storage_state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (storage_state IN ('pending', 'ready', 'cleanup_pending', 'missing')), CHECK(relative_path GLOB 'media/*' AND relative_path NOT LIKE '%..%' AND relative_path NOT LIKE '%\%' AND instr(relative_path, ':') = 0), CHECK(thumbnail_relative_path IS NULL OR(thumbnail_relative_path GLOB 'media/*' AND thumbnail_relative_path NOT LIKE '%..%' AND thumbnail_relative_path NOT LIKE '%\%' AND instr(thumbnail_relative_path, ':') = 0)));
CREATE INDEX media_session_kind ON media_assets (session_id, kind)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "skill_id" TEXT REFERENCES skills(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)), "local_time_h_hmm" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(local_time_h_hmm) = 5 AND local_time_h_hmm GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr(local_time_h_hmm, 1, 2) <= '23'), "weekdays_bitset" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (weekdays_bitset BETWEEN 1 AND 127), "iana_zone" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(iana_zone) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), "quiet_hours_override" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (quiet_hours_override IN (0, 1)), "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "os_notification_id" INTEGER UNIQUE, "last_scheduled_at_utc" INTEGER, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "data_migrations" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "completed_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "export_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archive_schema" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (archive_schema > 0), "byte_length" INTEGER CHECK (byte_length >= 0), "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('success', 'failure')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_cleanup_queue" ("relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "queued_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_metric_semantics BEFORE UPDATE ON metric_definitions WHEN NEW.id != OLD.id OR NEW.version != OLD.version OR NEW.skill_id != OLD.skill_id OR NEW.label != OLD.label OR NEW.unit_key != OLD.unit_key OR NEW.value_type != OLD.value_type OR NEW.direction != OLD.direction OR NEW.target_value IS NOT OLD.target_value OR NEW.scale_min IS NOT OLD.scale_min OR NEW.scale_max IS NOT OLD.scale_max OR NEW.source_hint != OLD.source_hint BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'metric_version_immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_goal_insert BEFORE INSERT ON goals WHEN NEW.metric_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.target_value IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_definitions AS d WHERE d.id = NEW.metric_definition_id AND d.version = NEW.definition_version AND d.skill_id = NEW.skill_id AND d.value_type = 'numeric' AND d.unit_key = NEW.target_unit) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'goal_metric_unit');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_goal_update BEFORE UPDATE ON goals WHEN NEW.metric_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.target_value IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_definitions AS d WHERE d.id = NEW.metric_definition_id AND d.version = NEW.definition_version AND d.skill_id = NEW.skill_id AND d.value_type = 'numeric' AND d.unit_key = NEW.target_unit) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'goal_metric_unit');END

CREATE TRIGGER next_metric_version BEFORE INSERT ON metric_definitions WHEN NEW.version != COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) + 1 FROM metric_definitions WHERE id = NEW.id), 1) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_definitions WHERE id = NEW.id AND skill_id != NEW.skill_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'metric_version_sequence');END

CREATE TRIGGER legal_session_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON sessions WHEN NEW.skill_id != OLD.skill_id OR NEW.id != OLD.id OR NEW.entry_mode != OLD.entry_mode OR NEW.manual_intent IS NOT OLD.manual_intent OR NEW.revision != OLD.revision + 1 OR(NEW.status != OLD.status AND NOT((OLD.status = 'draft' AND NEW.status IN ('running', 'completed', 'discarded'))OR(OLD.status = 'running' AND NEW.status IN ('paused', 'completed', 'discarded'))OR(OLD.status = 'paused' AND NEW.status IN ('running', 'completed', 'discarded'))))OR NEW.active_seconds < COALESCE((SELECT SUM(allocated_seconds) FROM session_exercises WHERE session_id = OLD.id), 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'session_conflict');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_exercise_insert BEFORE INSERT ON session_exercises WHEN(NEW.exercise_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercises AS e JOIN sessions AS s ON s.id = NEW.session_id WHERE e.id = NEW.exercise_id AND e.skill_id = s.skill_id))OR COALESCE(NEW.allocated_seconds, 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(allocated_seconds) FROM session_exercises WHERE session_id = NEW.session_id), 0) > (SELECT active_seconds FROM sessions WHERE id = NEW.session_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'exercise_allocation');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_exercise_update BEFORE UPDATE ON session_exercises WHEN(NEW.exercise_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercises AS e JOIN sessions AS s ON s.id = NEW.session_id WHERE e.id = NEW.exercise_id AND e.skill_id = s.skill_id))OR COALESCE(NEW.allocated_seconds, 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(allocated_seconds) FROM session_exercises WHERE session_id = NEW.session_id AND NOT(session_id = OLD.session_id AND ordinal = OLD.ordinal)), 0) > (SELECT active_seconds FROM sessions WHERE id = NEW.session_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'exercise_allocation');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_reading_insert BEFORE INSERT ON metric_readings WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_definitions AS d JOIN sessions AS s ON s.id = NEW.session_id WHERE d.id = NEW.metric_definition_id AND d.version = NEW.definition_version AND d.skill_id = s.skill_id AND((d.value_type = 'numeric' AND NEW.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.text_value IS NULL AND NEW.bool_value IS NULL AND(d.scale_min IS NULL OR NEW.numeric_value >= d.scale_min)AND(d.scale_max IS NULL OR NEW.numeric_value <= d.scale_max))OR(d.value_type = 'text' AND NEW.text_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.numeric_value IS NULL AND NEW.bool_value IS NULL)OR(d.value_type = 'checklist' AND NEW.bool_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.text_value IS NULL AND NEW.numeric_value IS NULL))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'reading_type_range_skill');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_reading_update BEFORE UPDATE ON metric_readings WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_definitions AS d JOIN sessions AS s ON s.id = NEW.session_id WHERE d.id = NEW.metric_definition_id AND d.version = NEW.definition_version AND d.skill_id = s.skill_id AND((d.value_type = 'numeric' AND NEW.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.text_value IS NULL AND NEW.bool_value IS NULL AND(d.scale_min IS NULL OR NEW.numeric_value >= d.scale_min)AND(d.scale_max IS NULL OR NEW.numeric_value <= d.scale_max))OR(d.value_type = 'text' AND NEW.text_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.numeric_value IS NULL AND NEW.bool_value IS NULL)OR(d.value_type = 'checklist' AND NEW.bool_value IS NOT NULL AND NEW.text_value IS NULL AND NEW.numeric_value IS NULL))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'reading_type_range_skill');END

CREATE TRIGGER cleanup_deleted_media AFTER DELETE ON media_assets BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO file_cleanup_queue (relative_path, queued_at_utc) VALUES (OLD.relative_path, unixepoch());INSERT OR IGNORE INTO file_cleanup_queue (relative_path, queued_at_utc) SELECT OLD.thumbnail_relative_path, unixepoch() WHERE OLD.thumbnail_relative_path IS NOT NULL;END

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_media_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON media_assets WHEN NEW.id != OLD.id OR NEW.session_id != OLD.session_id OR NEW.relative_path != OLD.relative_path OR NEW.thumbnail_relative_path IS NOT OLD.thumbnail_relative_path OR NEW.sha256 != OLD.sha256 OR NEW.byte_length != OLD.byte_length BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'media_identity_immutable');END
